method: Seven complete pinned files read and blobs checked. Original string/helper diagnostic functions AST-extracted and executed on synthetic inputs; terminal/package integrity checks mocked, no external process.
findings: lstrip accepts prefixes and rstrip accepts suffixes but both call _strip_impl with undefined xfixes. Direct original-function calls reproduce NameError. Generic strip passes xfixes correctly.

import_check terminal-size fallback catches EnvironmentError and prints warning but then uses local stderr that was never assigned. Synthetic terminal failure reproduces UnboundLocalError masking original import diagnostic.
pkg.check_integrity invokes md5sum with argv,cwdroot and wait; no timeout/cancellation shown. This diagnostic checks systempackage checksums, not file duplicate identity. It was not executed.

LazyInstance clears factory only after successful creation; factory exception permits retry despite at-most-once doc wording. Concurrent first access has no synchronization shown; no concurrent runtime control. Lazy bound method lambdas accept positional args only.

unique helper preserves first occurrence using ExtSet plus optional key; no byte comparison or collision verification beyond Python key equality. pairs/map_pairs use tee and shifted iterators, while foreach multiple inputs follows zip shortest semantics.

Function composition executes left-to-right and can return raw sole function; callable validation uses assert for multistage composition, disabled with optimized launcher. No failure claim for valid caller contracts.
Legacy fspath fallback accepts strings/bytes/bytearray and custom __fspath__ return without type validation. On modern Python native os.fspath takes precedence; fallback not executed.

terminal_fallback.message: cannot access local variable 'stderr' where it is not associated with a value

result.scope: Original AST-extracted helper functions; string calls and mocked diagnostic fallback only. No package integrity process,APTimport or system files accessed.

limits: No system configuration,APT/Pythonpackage checksum process,fullCLI/tests or production changes. Native pHash/ASAN deferred.
